# Project description checklist

This checklist is used when reviewing the main README/project description.

- [x] Explains what Tagvyn specifically adds and does.
- [x] Explains why a user/server operator may want to download Tagvyn.
- [x] Explains important pre-download requirements and limitations, including client + server installation, matching loader/Minecraft builds, and the distinction between display identity and the authenticated Minecraft username/GameProfile.

Technical implementation details should remain in Wiki/developer documentation rather than the main project description.
